summary: Brell’s Forge is the molten heart of Underfoot, where divine craftsmanship shapes stone, metal, and crystal. Rivers of magma flow through colossal caverns, powering the forges of Brell Serilis.
history: Brell’s Forge was the first structure created by Brell Serilis in Underfoot.
The divine forge hammers shaped the earliest stone guardians.
Magma rivers were channeled into controlled flows by Brell’s will.
Mortals first breached the Forge during the Age of Turmoil.
